g.text: I-6: C-304 STOPPED → FV-314 FORCED SHUT (DCS)
1. DESIGN CASE, LINE SIZING AND HOLD ITEMS AS SHEET 1 NOTES 1–7.
2. ALTERNATIVE VERSION OF PX-PID-302. STAGE 3: −29.0 °C, DRAW 129.0 t/h, CRYSTALS 30.5 wt%, RECYCLE 48.0 t/h.
3. JACKET C3= −35.0 °C / 1.75 bar a; DUTY 2.70 MW (DESIGN TAB). PSV-330 SET 20 barg (HOLD).
4. FIC-320 RECYCLE FV-320 FAILS OPEN (MODEL): ON AIR FAILURE THE FILTRATE RETURNS TO V-302.
5. CAKE CHUTE FROM THE CENTRIFUGE TO V-401 IS A GRAVITY CHUTE (SOLIDS); NO VALVE.
A. TIC-310 → SP OF PIC-311 → PV-311. LIC-313 → FV-314; LSLL-325 FORCES FV-314 SHUT (DCS).
C. I-1: LSHH-317 (> 92 %, 5 s) → CLOSE XV-100 (SHT 1).
D. I-6 (DCS): C-304 STOPPED → FV-314 FORCED SHUT.
